# Task 3

```{r}
# -Load corpus from folder
corpus_dir <- "Corpus" 

docs <- VCorpus(DirSource(corpus_dir, encoding = "UTF-8"),
                readerControl = list(language = "en"))

# Verify documents loaded
cat("Number of documents:", length(docs), "\n")
cat("Document names:\n")
print(names(docs))

# Text transformations / cleaning

# Convert to lowercase
docs <- tm_map(docs, content_transformer(tolower))

# Remove URLs (common artefact in web-scraped text)
remove_url <- function(x) gsub("http\\S+|www\\.\\S+", "", x)
docs <- tm_map(docs, content_transformer(remove_url))

# Remove numbers
docs <- tm_map(docs, removeNumbers)

# Remove punctuation
docs <- tm_map(docs, removePunctuation)

# Remove common English stopwords
custom_stopwords <- c(stopwords("english"),
                      "also", "can", "just", "like", "even", "still",
                      "want", "know", "will", "one", "need", "get", 
                      "now", "fine", "turn")
docs <- tm_map(docs, removeWords, custom_stopwords)

# Strip extra whitespace
docs <- tm_map(docs, stripWhitespace)

# Stem words (reduce to root form)
docs <- tm_map(docs, stemDocument)

# Build the Document-Term Matrix
dtm <- DocumentTermMatrix(docs)

cat("\nDTM dimensions (before sparsity removal):",
    dim(dtm)[1], "documents x", dim(dtm)[2], "terms\n")

# Remove sparse terms
dtm_sparse <- removeSparseTerms(dtm, sparse = 0.65)

cat("DTM dimensions (after sparsity removal):",
    dim(dtm_sparse)[1], "documents x", dim(dtm_sparse)[2], "terms\n")

# Check how many tokens remain
cat("Tokens retained:", ncol(dtm_sparse), "\n")
cat("Terms:\n")
print(Terms(dtm_sparse))

# Inspect and display the DTM
dtm_matrix <- as.matrix(dtm_sparse)
print(dtm_matrix)

```

# Task 4

```{r}
library(proxy)       # cosine distance
library(igraph)      # network graphs
library(ggplot2)     # plotting
library(RColorBrewer)
library(dendextend)
```

```{r}
# Cosine distance matrix from DTM
dtm_matrix <- as.matrix(dtm_sparse)
cosine_dist <- dist(dtm_matrix, method = "cosine")

# Hierarchical clustering (Ward's method)
hclust_result <- hclust(cosine_dist, method = "ward.D2")

# Genre labels for colouring
genres <- c(rep("Music", 5), rep("News", 5), rep("Recipe", 5), rep("Review", 5))
genre_colours <- c("Music" = "steelblue", "News" = "tomato",
                   "Recipe" = "forestgreen", "Review" = "purple")
label_colours <- genre_colours[genres]

# Plot dendrogram
plot(hclust_result,
     main = "Hierarchical Clustering of Corpus (Cosine Distance)",
     xlab = "", sub = "",
     ylab = "Height",
     cex = 0.8)

# Colour leaf labels by genre
dend <- as.dendrogram(hclust_result)
dend <- color_labels(dend, col = label_colours[order.dendrogram(dend)])
plot(dend, main = "Hierarchical Clustering by Genre (Cosine Distance)")
legend("topleft", 
       legend = names(genre_colours),
       fill   = genre_colours, 
       title  = "Genre", 
       cex    = 0.8,
       inset  = c(0.01, 0.01),  # slight padding from corner
       bg     = "white",         # white background so it's readable
       box.lty = 1)

# Cut tree into k clusters
k <- 4
clusters <- cutree(hclust_result, k = k)
cat("Cluster assignments:\n")
print(clusters)

# Accuracy: compare clusters to true genres
genre_labels <- rep(c("Music","News","Recipe","Review"), each = 5)
cluster_df <- data.frame(doc = names(clusters),
                         cluster = clusters,
                         genre = genre_labels)
cat("\nCluster vs Genre table:\n")
print(table(cluster_df$cluster, cluster_df$genre))

# Acuracy: majority genre per cluster
cluster_accuracy <- function(clusters, genres) {
  df <- data.frame(cluster = clusters, genre = genres)
  correct <- sum(sapply(unique(clusters), function(c) {
    sub <- df[df$cluster == c, "genre"]
    max(table(sub))
  }))
  correct / length(genres)
}
acc <- cluster_accuracy(clusters, genre_labels)
cat(sprintf("\nClustering accuracy: %.1f%%\n", acc * 100))
```

```{r}
# Confusion Matrix

# Map cluster numbers to genre names by majority vote
cluster_to_genre <- sapply(1:k, function(c) {
  sub <- genre_labels[clusters == c]
  names(which.max(table(sub)))
})
cat("Cluster to Genre mapping:\n")
print(data.frame(Cluster = 1:k, Assigned_Genre = cluster_to_genre))

# Predict genre for each document
predicted_genre <- factor(cluster_to_genre[clusters], 
                          levels = c("Music","News","Recipe","Review"))
actual_genre    <- factor(genre_labels, 
                          levels = c("Music","News","Recipe","Review"))

# Confusion matrix (Actual = rows, Predicted = columns)
conf_table <- table(Actual = actual_genre, Predicted = predicted_genre)
cat("\nConfusion Matrix (Actual vs Predicted):\n")
print(conf_table)

# Per-cluster accuracy
per_cluster_acc <- sapply(c("Music","News","Recipe","Review"), function(g) {
  row <- conf_table[g, ]
  round(max(row) / sum(row), 2)
})
cat("\nPer-Genre Accuracy:\n")
print(data.frame(Genre = names(per_cluster_acc), Accuracy = per_cluster_acc))

# Overall accuracy
overall_acc <- sum(diag(conf_table)) / sum(conf_table)
cat(sprintf("\nOverall Accuracy: %.1f%%\n", overall_acc * 100))
```

```{r}
# Table 4.4: Top distinctive terms per genre
genre_labels <- rep(c("Music","News","Recipe","Review"), each = 5)

# Sum term frequencies by genre
genre_term_matrix <- aggregate(dtm_matrix, 
                                by = list(Genre = genre_labels), 
                                FUN = sum)

# Set genre names as row names
rownames(genre_term_matrix) <- genre_term_matrix$Genre
genre_term_matrix$Genre <- NULL

# Print top 5 terms per genre
for (g in c("Music", "News", "Recipe", "Review")) {
  row <- as.numeric(genre_term_matrix[g, ])          # convert to numeric vector
  names(row) <- colnames(genre_term_matrix)           # restore term names
  row_sorted <- sort(row, decreasing = TRUE)          # now sort works
  cat(g, ":", paste(names(row_sorted)[1:5], collapse = ", "), "\n")
}
```

# Task 5

```{r}
# Analyse sentiment directly from corpus
# Standard NLP tokenizing performed automatically
SentimentA <- analyzeSentiment(docs)

cat("Sentiment scores:\n")
print(SentimentA)

# Add genre labels
SentimentA$genre <- genre_labels

# Mean by genre
cat("\nMean SentimentGI by genre:\n")
print(aggregate(SentimentGI ~ genre, data = SentimentA, FUN = mean))

cat("\nMean PositivityGI by genre:\n")
print(aggregate(PositivityGI ~ genre, data = SentimentA, FUN = mean))

# SD by genre
cat("\nSD SentimentGI by genre:\n")
print(aggregate(SentimentGI ~ genre, data = SentimentA, FUN = sd))

# Boxplots (4 measures like lecture slide 24)
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
boxplot(WordCount   ~ genre, data = SentimentA, main = "Word Count",
        col = c("steelblue","tomato","forestgreen","purple"), frame = TRUE)
boxplot(SentimentGI ~ genre, data = SentimentA, main = "Sentiment GI",
        col = c("steelblue","tomato","forestgreen","purple"), frame = TRUE)
boxplot(PositivityGI ~ genre, data = SentimentA, main = "Positivity GI",
        col = c("steelblue","tomato","forestgreen","purple"), frame = TRUE)
boxplot(NegativityGI ~ genre, data = SentimentA, main = "Negativity GI",
        col = c("steelblue","tomato","forestgreen","purple"), frame = TRUE)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

# ANOVA: test if SentimentGI differs significantly across genres
anova_result <- aov(SentimentGI ~ genre, data = SentimentA)
cat("\nANOVA result (SentimentGI):\n")
print(summary(anova_result))

kable(aggregate(SentimentGI ~ genre, data = SentimentA, FUN = mean),
      col.names = c("Genre", "Mean SentimentGI"),
      digits  = 4,
      caption = "Table 5.1 - Mean Sentiment (GI Dictionary) by Genre")

kable(aggregate(SentimentGI ~ genre, data = SentimentA, FUN = sd),
      col.names = c("Genre", "SD SentimentGI"),
      digits  = 4,
      caption = "Table 5.2 - Sentiment Variability by Genre")
```

# Task 6

```{r}
# Helper: rescale vector to a range
rescale <- function(x, to = c(0, 1)) {
  if (max(x) == min(x)) return(rep(mean(to), length(x)))
  (x - min(x)) / (max(x) - min(x)) * (to[2] - to[1]) + to[1]
}

# Binary DTM
dtm_binary <- as.matrix(dtm_sparse)
dtm_binary[dtm_binary > 0] <- 1

kable(dtm_binary,
      caption  = "Table 6.1 – Binary Document-Term Matrix",
      booktabs = FALSE) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed", "bordered"),
                full_width = FALSE,
                font_size  = 10)

# Shared Term Matrix
doc_adj <- dtm_binary %*% t(dtm_binary)
diag(doc_adj) <- 0

kable(doc_adj,
      caption  = "Table 6.2 – Shared Term Matrix (Document Adjacency)",
      booktabs = FALSE) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed", "bordered"),
                full_width = FALSE,
                font_size  = 10)

# Build graph
doc_graph_basic <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(
  doc_adj,
  mode     = "undirected",
  weighted = TRUE,
  diag     = FALSE
)

# Basic plot
set.seed(42)
plot(doc_graph_basic,
     vertex.label     = gsub("\\.txt", "", V(doc_graph_basic)$name),
     vertex.label.cex = 0.7,
     main             = "Figure 6.1 – Document Network (Basic)")

# Improved plot 
doc_graph <- doc_graph_basic

# Genre colours
genre_col <- c(
  Music  = "#FFD700",  # gold
  News   = "#FF4500",  # orange-red
  Recipe = "#00CC44",  # green
  Review = "#9933FF"   # purple
)

V(doc_graph)$genre <- genre_labels
V(doc_graph)$color <- genre_col[V(doc_graph)$genre]

# Degree centrality → node size
deg <- degree(doc_graph)

V(doc_graph)$size <- rescale(
  deg,
  to = c(12, 35)
)

# Edge width = similarity
E(doc_graph)$width <- rescale(
  E(doc_graph)$weight,
  to = c(0.5, 6)
)

# Edge transparency
edge_alpha <- rescale(
  E(doc_graph)$weight,
  to = c(0.15, 0.85)
)

E(doc_graph)$color <- rgb(
  0.4, 0.4, 0.4,
  alpha = edge_alpha
)

# Sentiment border colour
sent_scores <- SentimentA$SentimentGI

sent_norm <- rescale(
  sent_scores,
  to = c(0, 1)
)

sent_pal <- colorRamp(
  c("red", "white", "dodgerblue")
)

sent_rgb <- sent_pal(sent_norm)

V(doc_graph)$frame.color <- rgb(
  sent_rgb[,1],
  sent_rgb[,2],
  sent_rgb[,3],
  maxColorValue = 255
)

# Community detection
set.seed(42)

community <- cluster_louvain(doc_graph)

V(doc_graph)$community <- membership(community)


# Layout
set.seed(42)

layout_fr <- layout_with_fr(
  doc_graph,
  niter = 2000
)

# Plot with community hulls using mark.groups (cleaner)
# Get community membership
comm_members <- membership(community)
n_comm <- length(unique(comm_members))

# One hull colour per community
hull_fills   <- adjustcolor(c("cyan", "pink", "lightgreen", "lightyellow"), alpha.f = 0.25)
hull_borders <- adjustcolor(c("cyan", "pink", "lightgreen", "lightyellow"), alpha.f = 0.60)

# Build mark.groups list
mark_groups <- lapply(sort(unique(comm_members)), function(i) {
  which(comm_members == i)
})

par(mar = c(2, 1, 4, 10))

plot(
  doc_graph,
  layout             = layout_fr,
  mark.groups        = mark_groups,
  mark.col           = hull_fills[1:n_comm],
  mark.border        = hull_borders[1:n_comm],
  vertex.label       = gsub("\\.txt", "", V(doc_graph)$name),
  vertex.label.cex   = 0.70,
  vertex.label.font  = 2,
  vertex.label.color = "black",
  vertex.size        = V(doc_graph)$size,
  vertex.color       = V(doc_graph)$color,
  vertex.frame.color = V(doc_graph)$frame.color,
  vertex.frame.width = 3,
  edge.width         = E(doc_graph)$width,
  edge.color         = E(doc_graph)$color,
  edge.curved        = 0.25,
  main               = "Figure 6.2 – Document Network (Improved)\nNode size = degree centrality  |  Edge width = similarity  |  Border = sentiment"
)

# Genre legend
legend(
  x      = par("usr")[2] + 0.05,
  y      = par("usr")[4],
  legend = names(genre_col),
  fill   = genre_col,
  title  = "Genre (fill)",
  cex    = 0.8,
  bty    = "n",
  xpd    = TRUE
)

# Sentiment legend
legend(
  x      = par("usr")[2] + 0.05,
  y      = par("usr")[4] - 1,
  legend = c("Positive", "Neutral", "Negative"),
  fill   = c("dodgerblue", "white", "red"),
  border = "grey50",
  title  = "Sentiment GI\n(border colour)",
  cex    = 0.8,
  bty    = "n",
  xpd    = TRUE
)

par(mar = c(5, 4, 4, 2))

# Centrality table 
centrality_df <- data.frame(
  Document    = gsub("\\.txt", "", V(doc_graph)$name),
  Genre       = V(doc_graph)$genre,
  Degree      = degree(doc_graph),
  Closeness   = round(closeness(doc_graph, normalized = TRUE), 4),
  Betweenness = round(betweenness(doc_graph, normalized = TRUE), 4),
  Eigenvector = round(eigen_centrality(doc_graph)$vector, 4),
  Sentiment   = round(sent_scores, 4),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

centrality_df <- centrality_df[order(-centrality_df$Degree), ]

kable(centrality_df,
      caption   = "Table 6.3 – Document Centrality Measures (sorted by Degree)",
      row.names = FALSE,
      col.names = c("Document", "Genre", "Degree",
                    "Closeness (norm.)", "Betweenness (norm.)",
                    "Eigenvector", "Sentiment GI")) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE) |>
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) |>
  column_spec(3, bold = TRUE)

# Top 5 rankings table
top_n <- 5

rankings_table <- data.frame(
  Rank                   = 1:top_n,
  `Ranked by Betweenness` = centrality_df$Document[order(-centrality_df$Betweenness)][1:top_n],
  `Ranked by Closeness`   = centrality_df$Document[order(-centrality_df$Closeness)][1:top_n],
  `Ranked by Eigenvector` = centrality_df$Document[order(-centrality_df$Eigenvector)][1:top_n],
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

kable(rankings_table,
      caption   = "Table 6.4 – Top 5 Documents by Centrality Measure",
      row.names = FALSE) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE) |>
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)

# Community membership table ---
community_df <- data.frame(
  Document  = gsub("\\.txt", "", names(membership(community))),
  Genre     = genre_labels,
  Community = membership(community),
  Degree    = degree(doc_graph)[names(membership(community))],
  Sentiment = round(sent_scores, 4),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
community_df <- community_df[order(community_df$Community, community_df$Genre), ]

kable(community_df,
      caption   = "Table 6.5 – Community Membership with Sentiment",
      row.names = FALSE,
      col.names = c("Document", "Genre", "Community", "Degree", "Sentiment GI")) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE) |>
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)

# Confusion table + accuracy
conf_table <- table(Genre     = community_df$Genre,
                    Community = community_df$Community)

kable(as.data.frame.matrix(conf_table),
      caption = "Table 6.6 – Community Detection vs Genre (Confusion Matrix)") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE) |>
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "Detected Community" = ncol(conf_table))) |>
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)

n_correct <- sum(apply(conf_table, 2, max))
accuracy  <- n_correct / nrow(community_df)
cat(sprintf("Community Detection Accuracy (best-match): %.4f (%.1f%%)\n",
            accuracy, accuracy * 100))

# Isolated documents
isolated <- V(doc_graph)$name[degree(doc_graph) == 0]
if (length(isolated) > 0) {
  kable(data.frame(Isolated_Documents = gsub("\\.txt", "", isolated)),
        caption = "Table 6.7 – Isolated Documents (no shared terms)") |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped"), full_width = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("No isolated documents — all documents share at least one term.\n")
}
```

# Task 7

```{r}
# Transpose DTM to get Term-Document Matrix 
# Columns = documents, Rows = tokens
# Binary version: 1 if token appears in document, 0 otherwise
tdm_binary <- t(dtm_binary)   # reuse binary DTM from Task 6

# Token Co-occurrence Matrix (Shared Term Matrix)
# Multiply TDM by its transpose → 26x26 adjacency matrix
# Each cell = number of documents both tokens co-occur in
token_adj <- tdm_binary %*% t(tdm_binary)
diag(token_adj) <- 0   # remove self-connections

kable(token_adj,
      caption  = "Table 7.1 – Token Co-occurrence Matrix",
      booktabs = FALSE) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed", "bordered"),
                full_width = FALSE,
                font_size  = 10)

# Build basic token graph 
token_graph_basic <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(
  token_adj,
  mode     = "undirected",
  weighted = TRUE,
  diag     = FALSE
)

# Basic plot
set.seed(42)
plot(token_graph_basic,
     vertex.label     = V(token_graph_basic)$name,
     vertex.label.cex = 0.7,
     main             = "Figure 7.1 – Token Network (Basic)")

# Improved Token Network
token_graph <- token_graph_basic

# Node size = degree centrality (how many other tokens
# this token co-occurs with)
tok_deg <- degree(token_graph)

V(token_graph)$size <- rescale(tok_deg, to = c(8, 30))

# Node colour = eigenvector centrality band
tok_eig <- eigen_centrality(token_graph)$vector

eig_norm   <- rescale(tok_eig, to = c(0, 1))
eig_pal    <- colorRamp(c("#d0e8ff", "#1a6bbf"))   # light → deep blue
eig_rgb    <- eig_pal(eig_norm)
V(token_graph)$color <- rgb(eig_rgb[,1], eig_rgb[,2], eig_rgb[,3],
                             maxColorValue = 255)

# Edge width + transparency = co-occurrence strength
E(token_graph)$width <- rescale(E(token_graph)$weight, to = c(0.3, 6))

edge_alpha_tok <- rescale(E(token_graph)$weight, to = c(0.10, 0.80))
E(token_graph)$color <- rgb(0.4, 0.4, 0.4, alpha = edge_alpha_tok)

# Node label size scales with degree 
V(token_graph)$label.cex <- rescale(tok_deg, to = c(0.55, 1.0))

# Community detection (Louvain)
set.seed(42)
tok_community  <- cluster_louvain(token_graph)
tok_membership <- membership(tok_community)
V(token_graph)$community <- tok_membership

# Hull colours
n_tok_comm     <- length(unique(tok_membership))
tok_hull_fills   <- adjustcolor(
  c("pink","cyan","lightgreen","lightyellow","lightsalmon"),
  alpha.f = 0.25)[1:n_tok_comm]
tok_hull_borders <- adjustcolor(
  c("pink","cyan","lightgreen","lightyellow","lightsalmon"),
  alpha.f = 0.60)[1:n_tok_comm]

tok_mark_groups <- lapply(sort(unique(tok_membership)), function(i) {
  which(tok_membership == i)
})


# Layout
set.seed(42)
tok_layout <- layout_with_fr(token_graph, niter = 2000)

# Plot
par(mar = c(2, 1, 4, 10))

plot(
  token_graph,
  layout             = tok_layout,
  mark.groups        = tok_mark_groups,
  mark.col           = tok_hull_fills,
  mark.border        = tok_hull_borders,
  vertex.label       = V(token_graph)$name,
  vertex.label.cex   = V(token_graph)$label.cex,
  vertex.label.font  = 2,
  vertex.label.color = "black",
  vertex.size        = V(token_graph)$size,
  vertex.color       = V(token_graph)$color,
  vertex.frame.color = "grey40",
  edge.width         = E(token_graph)$width,
  edge.color         = E(token_graph)$color,
  edge.curved        = 0.2,
  main               = "Figure 7.2 – Token Network (Improved)"
)

# Eigenvector centrality colour legend
legend(
  x      = par("usr")[2] + 0.05,
  y      = par("usr")[4],
  legend = c("High influence", "Low influence"),
  fill   = c("#1a6bbf", "#d0e8ff"),
  title  = "Eigenvector\nCentrality",
  cex    = 0.8,
  bty    = "n",
  xpd    = TRUE
)

par(mar = c(5, 4, 4, 2))

# Token Centrality Table
tok_centrality_df <- data.frame(
  Token       = V(token_graph)$name,
  Degree      = degree(token_graph),
  Closeness   = round(closeness(token_graph, normalized = TRUE), 4),
  Betweenness = round(betweenness(token_graph, normalized = TRUE), 4),
  Eigenvector = round(eigen_centrality(token_graph)$vector, 4),
  Community   = tok_membership,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

tok_centrality_df <- tok_centrality_df[order(-tok_centrality_df$Degree), ]

kable(tok_centrality_df,
      caption   = "Table 7.2 – Token Centrality Measures (sorted by Degree)",
      row.names = FALSE,
      col.names = c("Token", "Degree", "Closeness (norm.)",
                    "Betweenness (norm.)", "Eigenvector", "Community")) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE) |>
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) |>
  column_spec(2, bold = TRUE)

# Top 5 rankings
top_n <- 5

tok_rankings <- data.frame(
  Rank                    = 1:top_n,
  `Ranked by Betweenness` = tok_centrality_df$Token[order(-tok_centrality_df$Betweenness)][1:top_n],
  `Ranked by Closeness`   = tok_centrality_df$Token[order(-tok_centrality_df$Closeness)][1:top_n],
  `Ranked by Eigenvector` = tok_centrality_df$Token[order(-tok_centrality_df$Eigenvector)][1:top_n],
  check.names      = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

kable(tok_rankings,
      caption   = "Table 7.3 – Top 5 Tokens by Centrality Measure",
      row.names = FALSE) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE) |>
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)

# Community membership table
tok_community_df <- data.frame(
  Token     = V(token_graph)$name,
  Community = tok_membership,
  Degree    = degree(token_graph),
  Eigenvector = round(eigen_centrality(token_graph)$vector, 4),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
tok_community_df <- tok_community_df[order(tok_community_df$Community,
                                            -tok_community_df$Degree), ]

kable(tok_community_df,
      caption   = "Table 7.4 – Token Community Membership",
      row.names = FALSE,
      col.names = c("Token", "Community", "Degree", "Eigenvector")) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE) |>
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)

# Isolated tokens check
isolated_tok <- V(token_graph)$name[degree(token_graph) == 0]
if (length(isolated_tok) > 0) {
  kable(data.frame(Isolated_Tokens = isolated_tok),
        caption = "Table 7.5 – Isolated Tokens") |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped"), full_width = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("No isolated tokens — all tokens co-occur with at least one other token.\n")
}
```

# Task 8

```{r}
# Transform DTM into edge list format
# Each row = one document-token pair where token appears in document
dtm_matrix_full <- as.matrix(dtm_sparse)

# Convert to long-format data frame (document, token, weight)
bip_edges <- which(dtm_matrix_full > 0, arr.ind = TRUE)
bip_df <- data.frame(
  document = rownames(dtm_matrix_full)[bip_edges[, 1]],
  token    = colnames(dtm_matrix_full)[bip_edges[, 2]],
  weight   = dtm_matrix_full[bip_edges],
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Clean document names
bip_df$document <- gsub("\\.txt", "", bip_df$document)

cat("Number of document-token edges:", nrow(bip_df), "\n")
cat("Unique documents:", length(unique(bip_df$document)), "\n")
cat("Unique tokens:", length(unique(bip_df$token)), "\n")

# Build bipartite graph
bip_graph <- graph_from_data_frame(bip_df, directed = FALSE)

# Mark node types: TRUE = document, FALSE = token
V(bip_graph)$type <- V(bip_graph)$name %in% bip_df$document

cat("\nNode types:\n")
cat("Document nodes:", sum(V(bip_graph)$type), "\n")
cat("Token nodes:", sum(!V(bip_graph)$type), "\n")

# Verify bipartite structure
cat("Is bipartite:", is_bipartite(bip_graph), "\n")

# Basic bipartite plot
set.seed(42)

# Use bipartite layout
bip_layout <- layout_as_bipartite(bip_graph)

# Swap axes: documents on left, tokens on right (horizontal layout)
bip_layout_h <- bip_layout[, c(2, 1)]

plot(
  bip_graph,
  layout           = bip_layout_h,
  vertex.shape     = ifelse(V(bip_graph)$type, "circle", "square"),
  vertex.color     = ifelse(V(bip_graph)$type, "steelblue", "orange"),
  vertex.size      = 8,
  vertex.label.cex = 0.6,
  vertex.label.color = "black",
  edge.width       = 0.5,
  edge.color       = "grey70",
  main             = "Figure 8.1 – Bipartite Network (Basic)\nCircles = Documents  |  Squares = Tokens"
)

legend("bottomleft",
       legend = c("Document", "Token"),
       pch    = c(21, 22),
       pt.bg  = c("steelblue", "orange"),
       pt.cex = 1.5,
       cex    = 0.8,
       bty    = "n")

# Improved Bipartite Plot
bip_imp <- bip_graph

# Node colour
# Documents → coloured by genre
# Tokens    → coloured by degree (how many docs they appear in)

# Genre colours for document nodes (reuse from Task 6)
doc_names_clean <- gsub("\\.txt", "", names(docs))

V(bip_imp)$genre <- ifelse(
  V(bip_imp)$type,
  genre_labels[match(V(bip_imp)$name, doc_names_clean)],
  "Token"
)

genre_col_bip <- c(
  Music  = "#FFD700",
  News   = "#FF4500",
  Recipe = "#00CC44",
  Review = "#9933FF",
  Token  = "#FF8C00"   # orange for token nodes
)

V(bip_imp)$color <- genre_col_bip[V(bip_imp)$genre]

# Node size
# Documents → scaled by degree (number of tokens used)
# Tokens    → scaled by degree (number of documents appeared in)
bip_deg <- degree(bip_imp)

V(bip_imp)$size <- rescale(bip_deg, to = c(6, 28))


# Node shape
# Documents = circle, Tokens = square
V(bip_imp)$shape <- ifelse(V(bip_imp)$type, "circle", "square")

# Node border colour for documents = sentiment
sent_norm_bip <- rescale(sent_scores, to = c(0, 1))
sent_pal_bip  <- colorRamp(c("red", "white", "dodgerblue"))
sent_rgb_bip  <- sent_pal_bip(sent_norm_bip)
sent_colors_bip <- rgb(sent_rgb_bip[,1], sent_rgb_bip[,2], sent_rgb_bip[,3],
                        maxColorValue = 255)

# Apply border colour: sentiment for docs, grey for tokens
V(bip_imp)$frame.color <- ifelse(
  V(bip_imp)$type,
  sent_colors_bip[match(V(bip_imp)$name, doc_names_clean)],
  "grey40"
)


# Edge width = term frequency weight
E(bip_imp)$width <- rescale(E(bip_imp)$weight, to = c(0.3, 4))

edge_alpha_bip  <- rescale(E(bip_imp)$weight, to = c(0.15, 0.75))
E(bip_imp)$color <- rgb(0.4, 0.4, 0.4, alpha = edge_alpha_bip)

# Layout — Fruchterman-Reingold separates the two node
# types better than bipartite layout for dense graphs
set.seed(42)
bip_layout_fr <- layout_with_fr(bip_imp, niter = 3000)

# Plot
par(mar = c(2, 1, 4, 11))

plot(
  bip_imp,
  layout             = bip_layout_fr,
  vertex.shape       = V(bip_imp)$shape,
  vertex.size        = V(bip_imp)$size,
  vertex.color       = V(bip_imp)$color,
  vertex.frame.color = V(bip_imp)$frame.color,
  vertex.frame.width = 2.5,
  vertex.label       = V(bip_imp)$name,
  vertex.label.cex   = ifelse(V(bip_imp)$type, 0.65, 0.60),
  vertex.label.font  = 2,
  vertex.label.color = "black",
  edge.width         = E(bip_imp)$width,
  edge.color         = E(bip_imp)$color,
  edge.curved        = 0.15,
  main               = "Figure 8.2 – Bipartite Network (Improved)"
)

# Genre legend (document nodes)
legend(
  x      = par("usr")[2] + 0.05,
  y      = par("usr")[4],
  legend = c("Music", "News", "Recipe", "Review"),
  fill   = c("#FFD700", "#FF4500", "#00CC44", "#9933FF"),
  title  = "Document Genre\n(circle fill)",
  cex    = 0.8,
  bty    = "n",
  xpd    = TRUE
)

# Token legend
legend(
  x      = par("usr")[2] + 0.05,
  y      = par("usr")[4] - 0.8,
  legend = "Token",
  fill   = "#FF8C00",
  title  = "Token nodes\n(squares)",
  cex    = 0.8,
  bty    = "n",
  xpd    = TRUE
)

# Sentiment legend
legend(
  x      = par("usr")[2] + 0.05,
  y      = par("usr")[4] - 1.5,
  legend = c("Positive", "Neutral", "Negative"),
  fill   = c("dodgerblue", "white", "red"),
  border = "grey50",
  title  = "Sentiment GI\n(doc border)",
  cex    = 0.8,
  bty    = "n",
  xpd    = TRUE
)

par(mar = c(5, 4, 4, 2))

# Centrality tables
# Separate document and token nodes
doc_nodes   <- V(bip_imp)$name[V(bip_imp)$type]
token_nodes <- V(bip_imp)$name[!V(bip_imp)$type]

# Document centrality
doc_centrality_df <- data.frame(
  Document    = doc_nodes,
  Genre       = genre_labels[match(doc_nodes, doc_names_clean)],
  Degree      = degree(bip_imp)[doc_nodes],
  Closeness   = round(closeness(bip_imp, normalized = TRUE)[doc_nodes], 4),
  Betweenness = round(betweenness(bip_imp, normalized = TRUE)[doc_nodes], 4),
  Sentiment   = round(sent_scores[match(doc_nodes, doc_names_clean)], 4),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
doc_centrality_df <- doc_centrality_df[order(-doc_centrality_df$Degree), ]

kable(doc_centrality_df,
      caption   = "Table 8.1 – Document Node Centrality in Bipartite Network",
      row.names = FALSE,
      col.names = c("Document", "Genre", "Degree",
                    "Closeness (norm.)", "Betweenness (norm.)", "Sentiment GI")) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE) |>
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) |>
  column_spec(3, bold = TRUE)

# Token centrality
tok_centrality_bip_df <- data.frame(
  Token       = token_nodes,
  Degree      = degree(bip_imp)[token_nodes],
  Closeness   = round(closeness(bip_imp, normalized = TRUE)[token_nodes], 4),
  Betweenness = round(betweenness(bip_imp, normalized = TRUE)[token_nodes], 4),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
tok_centrality_bip_df <- tok_centrality_bip_df[order(-tok_centrality_bip_df$Degree), ]

kable(tok_centrality_bip_df,
      caption   = "Table 8.2 – Token Node Centrality in Bipartite Network",
      row.names = FALSE,
      col.names = c("Token", "Degree (docs containing token)",
                    "Closeness (norm.)", "Betweenness (norm.)")) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE) |>
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) |>
  column_spec(2, bold = TRUE)

# Which documents share the most tokens
# Project bipartite graph onto document side
bip_proj <- bipartite_projection(bip_imp, which = "true")

doc_shared <- as_data_frame(bip_proj, what = "edges")
doc_shared <- doc_shared[order(-doc_shared$weight), ]

kable(head(doc_shared, 10),
      caption   = "Table 8.3 – Top 10 Document Pairs by Shared Tokens (Bipartite Projection)",
      row.names = FALSE,
      col.names = c("Document A", "Document B", "Shared Tokens")) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE) |>
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)

# Which tokens appear in the most documents
token_doc_count <- data.frame(
  Token    = token_nodes,
  NumDocs  = degree(bip_imp)[token_nodes],
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
token_doc_count <- token_doc_count[order(-token_doc_count$NumDocs), ]

kable(token_doc_count,
      caption   = "Table 8.4 – Tokens by Number of Documents (Degree in Bipartite Network)",
      row.names = FALSE,
      col.names = c("Token", "Number of Documents")) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE) |>
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)
```
